sections.h2: What technician tracking software is, and what the app does
paras: Technician tracking software shows the office where each field engineer is, which job they are on, and what they did there, through a mobile app the engineer carries. In Aura Business the app is the field half of the platform: GPS check-in at the customer site, attendance marked with location and a selfie, a route for the day, and a mobile job card that captures fault, work done, spares, photos and the customer's signature.

Tracking on its own annoys engineers and helps nobody. The app earns its place because it removes the paperwork: the job card replaces the carbon copy, the photo replaces the WhatsApp forward, and the signature replaces the argument about whether the visit happened. The office gets the same data live, without a phone call.

sections.h2: Six things a service head cannot answer without an app.
sections.lead: Engineers are honest and busy. The problem is that everything they do is recorded on paper, by phone, or not at all.

items.p: A hospital calls to ask when the engineer will arrive and the answer is a phone call to the engineer, who is on a ladder.
'Reached site' on WhatsApp at 9.40 am is not an attendance record, and payroll cannot use it.
Two engineers cross the city in opposite directions to jobs that were next door to each other.
Radiology and lab rooms often have no signal, so the app that needs internet is not used there.
Photos arrive on someone's personal phone and the customer signature is a scanned page, if it exists.
A ventilator call goes to whoever is nearest, not to the engineer trained on that model.

items.q: Does it track engineers all day or only at check-in?
items.a: GPS check-in timestamps arrival at each customer site, and the HRMS suite includes GPS and field tracking for the office view. How continuous the tracking is can be set to suit your team and their consent, and is agreed during setup.

items.q: Will it work inside hospitals with no signal?
items.a: Yes. The job card, photos and signature are captured in offline mode and sync when the phone reconnects. Attendance and check-in also queue until a connection is available.

items.q: Is the app available on both Android and iOS?
items.a: Yes. Elevate Aura builds the mobile app in React Native or Flutter for Android and iOS, and it can be published under your own branding. See field service app development.

Each engineer's profile records the models and brands they are trained on. When the desk dispatches a call, it can filter and assign by skill as well as by area and schedule, so specialised equipment goes to the right person.

items.q: Can the same app be used by sales reps?
items.a: Yes. Field visits with GPS check-in, visit notes and the activity feed are part of the CRM suite, so sales and service staff use one app with different screens based on role.
The engineer shows the completed job card on the phone and the customer signs on screen. The signed job card is stored on the asset's service history and can be shared with the customer as a PDF.
